examples.title: Readability flags staccato on short output too
examples.stdin: Building products is hard. Not the technology. The people.
examples.failure_mode: Short de-slopped staccato must not slip through because the document has only three sentences.

examples.title: Phone number mangled into a range '555-123'
examples.failure_mode: The range regex grabs '555-123' from the phone number; the full number is never captured as a constraint.
examples.correct_behavior: The full phone number should be a constraint.

examples.title: structure_scan flags low sentence burstiness
examples.failure_mode: Uniform sentence lengths can pass phrase scans while still reading machine-shaped.

examples.title: structure_scan allows bursty human-shaped narrative
examples.failure_mode: A broad low-burstiness rule must not punish varied human narrative rhythm.

examples.title: structure_scan docs genre suppresses bold-colon listicle
examples.failure_mode: Reference docs and option lists legitimately use bold-label colon formatting.

examples.title: structure_scan social genre suppresses staccato cadence
examples.failure_mode: Social copy often deliberately uses one-line cadence.

examples.title: Spanish paragraph declined by structure_scan
examples.stdin: El rapido zorro marron salta sobre el perro perezoso. La casa esta cerca del rio y los ninos juegan en el jardin todas las tardes despues de la escuela.
examples.failure_mode: Structure metrics are meaningless on non-English prose but would still be reported.
examples.correct_behavior: Non-English detected: non_english true, zero violations, exit 0.

examples.title: silhouette_scan flags a templated preview-then-fulfill essay
examples.failure_mode: An essay can pass phrase and surface-structure scans while still following a machine outline: intro previews three pillars, each body paragraph opens on a rotating discourse cue and fulfills one pillar, and the ending loops the vocabulary back.
examples.correct_behavior: Exit 1 with silhouette_penalty flagged for arranging ideas as a symmetric template.

examples.title: A bursty human narrative is not a silhouette template
examples.failure_mode: A discourse-level scanner could punish any multi-paragraph prose, flagging genuine human storytelling that wanders and never previews or recaps itself.
examples.correct_behavior: Exit 0: no scaffold openers, no preview-fulfillment, no recap loop, so silhouette_penalty stays below 1.0.

examples.title: banned_phrase_scan: bad-bytes stdin still scans retained high-signal patterns
command: printf '\xff\xfeHere\x27s the thing: progress' | python3 scripts/banned_phrase_scan.py
examples.failure_mode: sys.stdin.read() raises an uncaught UnicodeDecodeError on non-UTF-8 stdin, so a host agent piping raw bytes gets a Python traceback instead of a JSON reply.
examples.correct_behavior: Decode with errors="replace" and keep scanning; the surviving text still trips a retained hard-severity pattern.

examples.title: Full compact scanner stays linear on a large adversarial document
command: import sys,time; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from scripts.banned_phrase_scan import scan_for_violations; s='\n'.join([' '.join(["Here\'s the thing: progress." for _ in range(10)]) for _ in range(800)]); t=time.perf_counter(); scan_for_violations(s); dt=time.perf_counter()-t; print(round(dt,3)); sys.exit(0 if dt<2.0 else 1)
examples.failure_mode: A retained pattern can backtrack or interact with the rule pack badly enough to stall normal validation.
examples.correct_behavior: Scanning 8,000 repeated trigger sentences through the complete runtime pack finishes in under two seconds.
